key: Frozen solid.
en: Frozen solid.
ja: 完全に凍りついている。

key: METEOR: Why are you like this?!
en: METEOR: Why are you like this?!
ja: メテオ: なんでお前はそうなんだよ?!

key: METEOR: You again!
en: METEOR: You again!
ja: メテオ: またお前か!

key: Oh no, no, no! Absolutely not!
en: Oh no, no, no! Absolutely not!
ja: あー嫌だ嫌だ嫌だ! 絶対にありえない!

key: Geoff, you deal with \PN while I teach this thing a lesson!
en: Geoff, you deal with \PN while I teach this thing a lesson!
ja: ジェフ、あたしがコイツに教育してやってる間、\PNの相手をお願い!

key: METEOR: Whatever you say.
en: METEOR: Whatever you say.
ja: メテオ: ま、好きにすれば。

key: I don't know what else she expected, really.
en: I don't know what else she expected, really.
ja: 正直、彼女が他に何を期待してたのか分からないな。

key: GLACEON: Glayyyy!!!
en: GLACEON: Glayyyy!!!
ja: グレイシア: グレァァ!!!

key: METEOR: Probably could've seen that coming too.
en: METEOR: Probably could've seen that coming too.
ja: メテオ: それも予想できたことだろうな。

key: Well, do whatever you want.
en: Well, do whatever you want.
ja: まあ、好きにしてくれ。

key: This damn thing has been giving us the runaround for a while, but it's not like I really care.
en: This damn thing has been giving us the runaround for a while, but it's not like I really care.
ja: こいつにはしばらく振り回されてたけど、別に気にしちゃいない。

key: GLACEON: Glay~ Glayceon!
en: GLACEON: Glay~ Glayceon!
ja: グレイシア: グレイ〜 グレイシア!

key: Glaceon seems ready to follow you now.
en: Glaceon seems ready to follow you now.
ja: グレイシアはあなたに懐いたようだ。

key: I suppose I should get a space heater or something for her.
en: I suppose I should get a space heater or something for her.
ja: こいつのために暖房でも用意してやるべきかもな。
……はぁ。

key: Locked.
en: Locked.
ja: 鍵がかかっている。

key: EAST DOOR UNLOCKED.
en: EAST DOOR UNLOCKED.
ja: 東のドアの鍵が開いた。

key: It's blocked.
en: It's blocked.
ja: ふさがっている。

key: WEST DOOR UNLOCKED.
en: WEST DOOR UNLOCKED.
ja: 西のドアの鍵が開いた。

key: So you got in after all.
en: So you got in after all.
ja: それでも、結局入ってきたか。

key: Well, whatever. I was tired of pet-sitting anyway.
en: Well, whatever. I was tired of pet-sitting anyway.
ja: まあ、どうでもいいけど。ペットの世話にはもう飽き飽きしてたし。

key: Those Pokémon have been running around this place for a bit now, causing havoc left and right.
en: Those Pokémon have been running around this place for a bit now, causing havoc left and right.
ja: あのポケモンたち、しばらく前からこの辺を走り回って、あちこち大暴れしてる。

key: Whoever let them loose will surely have another thing coming...
en: Whoever let them loose will surely have another thing coming...
ja: 逃がした奴は、あとでひどい目に遭うだろうよ……

key: ESPEON: Esp!!!
en: ESPEON: Esp!!!
ja: エーフィ: エーフ!!!

key: The cage is securely locked. A padlock holds it tightly in place.
en: The cage is securely locked. A padlock holds it tightly in place.
ja: おりはしっかりと施錠されている。南京錠でがっちり固定されているようだ。

key: METEOR: Not that it's really my place to say this, but the key for that cage isn't here.
en: METEOR: Not that it's really my place to say this, but the key for that cage isn't here.
ja: メテオ: あたしが言うことじゃないかもしれないけど、そのおりの鍵はここにはないよ。

key: That damn thing kept trying to steal it and free itself with telekinesis, so we had to hide it in another room.
en: That damn thing kept trying to steal it and free itself with telekinesis, so we had to hide it in another room.
ja: あの忌々しいやつ、念力で鍵を盗んで自分で逃げ出そうとしてたから、別の部屋に隠したんだ。

key: I think it's somewhere on the south side of the facility, but I wouldn't know where in particular.
en: I think it's somewhere on the south side of the facility, but I wouldn't know where in particular.
ja: たぶん施設の南側のどこかにあると思うけど、詳しい場所までは知らないよ。

key: So don't bother harassing us for it.
en: So don't bother harassing us for it.
ja: だからそれについて絡んでこないで。

key: \PN used the Cage Key!
en: \PN used the Cage Key!
ja: \PNは「おりのカギ」を使った!

key: METEOR: Oh. You already have it.
en: METEOR: Oh. You already have it.
ja: メテオ: あら。もう持ってるのね。

key: Well, ignore me then.
en: Well, ignore me then.
ja: じゃあ、あたしのことは無視してくれていいわ。

key: ESPEON: Espiii~
en: ESPEON: Espiii~
ja: エーフィ: エーフィ〜

key: GLACEON: Glaaay!
en: GLACEON: Glaaay!
ja: グレイシア: グレァ!

key: Espeon seems ready to follow you now.
en: Espeon seems ready to follow you now.
ja: エーフィはあなたに懐いたようだ。

key: METEOR: It's really cute that you're out here rescuing Pokémon and all, but that's not going to bring you any closer to the PULSE.
en: METEOR: It's really cute that you're out here rescuing Pokémon and all, but that's not going to bring you any closer to the PULSE.
ja: メテオ: ポケモンを助けて回ってるのは可愛らしいけど、それでPULSEに近づけるわけじゃないのよ。

key: METEOR: Do you really have to mention the PULSE?!
en: METEOR: Do you really have to mention the PULSE?!
ja: メテオ: PULSEのこと、わざわざ口に出す必要あるか?!

key: METEOR: Oh, please. \PN will find it anyway. There's no point in trying to hide it.
en: METEOR: Oh, please. \PN will find it anyway. There's no point in trying to hide it.
ja: メテオ: いいじゃない。どうせ\PNは見つけるわよ。隠したって無駄。

key: METEOR: At least shut up about it! Make them find it on their own!
en: METEOR: At least shut up about it! Make them find it on their own!
ja: メテオ: せめてそれについて黙ってろよ! 自分で見つけさせろって!

key: METEOR: In this mess? Yeah, that'd be a feat.
en: METEOR: In this mess? Yeah, that'd be a feat.
ja: メテオ: この混乱の中でか? そりゃすごいもんだな。

key: And especially with that menace on their tail.
en: And especially with that menace on their tail.
ja: しかもあの厄介者に追い回されながらな。

key: All it ever does is throw glass around.
en: All it ever does is throw glass around.
ja: あいつがやることといえばガラスをまき散らすことだけだ。

key: You know how much we had to clean up?
en: You know how much we had to clean up?
ja: どれだけ片付けさせられたと思ってるんだ?

key: Geez. Just take it away already.
en: Geez. Just take it away already.
ja: まったく。さっさと連れて行けよ。

key: METEOR: The key for that cage is somewhere else entirely.
en: METEOR: The key for that cage is somewhere else entirely.
ja: メテオ: そのおりの鍵は、まったく別の場所にあるぞ。

key: That's far enough!
en: That's far enough!
ja: そこまでだ!

key: This Espeon has caused enough trouble... Do you really need to make it more?
en: This Espeon has caused enough trouble... Do you really need to make it more?
ja: このエーフィは十分厄介事を起こしてきた……これ以上ひどくする必要が本当にあるのか?

key: Oh.
en: Oh.
ja: あ。

key: You found the key.
en: You found the key.
ja: 鍵を見つけたのか。

key: Well...
en: Well...
ja: まあ……

key: ...I guess that's for the best, in a way.
en: ...I guess that's for the best, in a way.
ja: ……ある意味、それが一番いいのかもな。

key: The cage can only be opened by a special key anyway.
en: The cage can only be opened by a special key anyway.
ja: どのみち、このおりは特別な鍵でしか開けられない。

key: And we don't have it, so it's not our problem.
en: And we don't have it, so it's not our problem.
ja: あたしたちはその鍵を持ってないから、あたしたちには関係ない話だ。

key: Glass breaks and \PN appears yet again. Just like my nightmares.
en: Glass breaks and \PN appears yet again. Just like my nightmares.
ja: ガラスが割れて、また\PNが現れる。まるであたしの悪夢みたいに。

key: The nightmare thing was a joke, just by the way. Mostly.
en: The nightmare thing was a joke, just by the way. Mostly.
ja: その悪夢の話は、一応冗談だからな。だいたいは。

key: If you got into this place, you'll probably have no problem getting into the elevator control room on the other side... as expected.
en: If you got into this place, you'll probably have no problem getting into the elevator control room on the other side... as expected.
ja: ここに入り込めたなら、反対側のエレベーター制御室にも問題なく入れるだろうな……予想通りだ。

key: ELEVATOR ACCESS RE-ENABLED.
en: ELEVATOR ACCESS RE-ENABLED.
ja: エレベーターアクセスが再有効化された。

key: ELEVATORS UNLOCKED.
en: ELEVATORS UNLOCKED.
ja: エレベーターのロックが解除された。

key: GROUND FLOOR ENTRANCE UNLOCKED.
en: GROUND FLOOR ENTRANCE UNLOCKED.
ja: 1階の入り口の鍵が開いた。

key: Ever since completing the other projects, there's been hardly anything for us to do...
en: Ever since completing the other projects, there's been hardly anything for us to do...
ja: 他のプロジェクトが完了してから、こっちにはほとんどやることがなくてね……

key: Is this really all Lin needs?
en: Is this really all Lin needs?
ja: これで本当にリンの望み通りなのか?

key: The PULSE's sleep wave can only be used on specific locations, so of course we had to shut off the elevators to keep you in line of it... but then how are you still here?
en: The PULSE's sleep wave can only be used on specific locations, so of course we had to shut off the elevators to keep you in line of it... but then how are you still here?
ja: PULSEの睡眠波は特定の場所でしか使えないから、エレベーターを止めてお前をその範囲に留めておく必要があったんだが……それなのに、なんでまだここにいるんだ?

key: Can't the guys outside do anything?
en: Can't the guys outside do anything?
ja: 外にいる連中は何もできないのか?

key: Cuz we sure can't.
en: Cuz we sure can't.
ja: あたしたちだって無理なのに。

key: To be frank, it's tedious to keep catching people in the elevators as we have. Entire parts of the facility become inaccessible-- not to mention the front door.
en: To be frank, it's tedious to keep catching people in the elevators as we have. Entire parts of the facility become inaccessible-- not to mention the front door.
ja: 正直言って、エレベーターでずっと人を捕まえ続けるのはうんざりだ。施設のあちこちが立ち入れなくなる――正面玄関はもちろんのこと。
